chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Do not apply clay on the grave from other than its own clay.

key_terms.طِينِهِ: its clay (referring to the grave's soil)

ai.seo_question: What type of clay should be used to plaster a grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi emphasizes the principle of simplicity and authenticity in burial rites, instructing that the clay used to seal or plaster the grave must be sourced directly from the excavation site rather than imported from elsewhere. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the rejection of unnecessary extravagance and reinforces the connection between the deceased and the earth from which they were taken, reflecting a broader Islamic ethic of humility in death.
